# Tower v0.8.8 - Table of Contents

Flexible exception tracking and reporting in Elixir

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Tower](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.md): Tower is a flexible error tracker for elixir applications.
- [Tower.EphemeralReporter](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.EphemeralReporter.md): A very slim and naive built-in reporter, that just stores Tower events as process state.
- [Tower.Event](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.Event.md): A struct representing a captured event.
- [Tower.Igniter](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.Igniter.md)
- [Tower.Reporter](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.Reporter.md): Behaviour that can be implemented to write Tower reporters.
- [Tower.Utils](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.Utils.md)

- Exceptions
  - [Tower.ReportEventError](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.ReportEventError.md)
  - [Tower.TestException](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Tower.TestException.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix tower.test](https://tower.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tower.Test.md)
